concepts.name: A 光层
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one macOS 27 application-icon concept preview for GainMapHDR, a professional native utility that converts photos to HDR HEIC with a gain map. Deliver a single square 1024x1024 image showing ONE centered rounded-square macOS app icon, front-on, occupying 82% of canvas, on a very light neutral gray presentation background. This is a preview of a layered Icon Composer design: an opaque background tile and a simple foreground symbol with restrained translucent glass material, gentle upper-left illumination, clear silhouette, precise geometry, clear at 32px. Elegant professional macOS aesthetic, modest dimensionality, excellent contrast. No text, no letters, no numbers, no captions, no Apple logo, no watermark, no UI screenshot, no surrounding objects, no elaborate illustration, no star sparkles, no excessive bloom, no perspective tilt. Concept A — Light Layers: two slightly offset upright photo plates stacked closely as one compact central symbol. Rear plate is translucent cool cyan gain-map glass, visible only along its top and right edges. Front plate contains an extremely simple abstract dark blue mountain/horizon silhouette with a single warm luminous sun; sweeping tonal transition from deep blue shadow to clear cyan light. Rounded-square background is subtly off-white with a pale icy-blue center. The symbol should read as a photographic image plus a supplemental light layer, not a generic document stack. Keep sun and horizon boldly readable, only 3 large visual shapes. Sophisticated quiet visual identity.
